title: Optimal-order mixing of the Thorp shuffle
main_claim: Thorp shuffle on n=2^d cards: TV(q_d^{*1600d}, U) -> 0 as d->infinity, and TV(q_d^{*t}, U) >= 1 - 2^{tn/2}/n!, so t_mix = Theta(d) (lower bound 2d - O(1)).
coverage:
Read the whole paper (main.tex, 601 lines) and checked every step of Thm 1.1.
(1) Model: the cyclic rotation frame, the support lower bound and its asymptotic form 2d-2log2(e)+o(1), and convergence in fixed dimension.
(2) Lemma 3.1, path cylinders: unvisited coins stay fair, giving average/transport updates, and the update carries the uniform vector on the free positions to the uniform vector on the next free set.
(3) Lemma 3.2, energy identity: the noise term ±w/2(δ_x-δ_x'), after j-1 further averages, has squared norm w^2/2^j. Cross terms vanish across times by the martingale property and within a time by independent signs. A full sweep annihilates the mean-zero part.
(4) Contraction: the d-1 layers between a=s-d+1 and s do not cross the halves of direction i_s. Given F_a, the switch arrays in the two halves are independent. The availability probability |B_a∩H|/(n/2) holds because each exposed card is marginally uniform. B_a is unconditionally uniform when the list is random. Hypergeometric Azuma tail e^{-m/32}, β=1/16, η=2e^{-n/256}. Recurrence induction: (1-β)/(2γ-1)=1, constant term η/β, base case uses E≤1≤γ^{neg}.
(5) Prop 4.2: the sequential-TV refinement, Cauchy-Schwarz, the sum over k≤n and 198·log2(32/31)≈9.07>8, giving ε_n=O(n^{-5/2}). Requirement m≥n/8 holds since k≤7n/8.
(6) Reciprocal-degree lemma: p(u)≤e^{3√u}; the three cases (tail u≤s/4 giving C(L,u)≥3^u; retained-diagram construction giving C(L,b)≥2^b; all hooks <s/4 giving (4/e)^s). The tableau constructions are valid.
(7) Lift: averaging over a random partition gives 8ε_n; coset removal costs ≤2δ_n; ν cap ≤4|H|/|G|. H-isotypic assignment to a factor of degree ≤D^{1/8}; cyclic-module dimension ≤Σb^2≤D^{3/8}Σ1/b≤C1·D^{3/8}; Schur average of projections; coset-constant comparison; A=√(32C1).
(8) Completion: Plancherel 4TV^2≤Σ D||â||_HS^2 with the normalization checked; exponent D^{2-16·5/16}=D^{-3}; sign coefficient bounded by (1-M)/M via last-coin flip; ||ν-μ||=1-M; 8 factors of 200d = 1600d, with R^{-T}=id since T is a multiple of d.
No numerical simulation was run; all constants were checked by hand.
